purpose: Post-outcome exploratory response-surface study at fixed Base demand: map how Security and Immigration capacity jointly change traveller delay, waiting queues, backlog, and clearance time.
post_outcome_disclosure: The grid was designed after inspection of the registered Part 2 results. It may generate operational insight and hypotheses, but it does not replace or modify the frozen confirmatory analysis.

selection_rationale.rule: Use every integer capacity across a bounded reduction range that crosses each stage's approximate rho=1 workload threshold, while retaining the 36/21 reference.
selection_rationale.boundary: These are experimental open-position settings, not an observed HTX roster, installed estate, or staffing recommendation.

seed_policy.reuse_rule: For replication r, every capacity cell uses the exact Base-demand master, arrival, service, routing, and tie seed tuple from the registered confirmatory manifest.
seed_policy.paired_interpretation_gate: Exact seed-tuple, arrival-trace, and traveller-level exogenous-draw alignment must pass before paired contrasts are reported.
seed_policy.cross_batch_reproducibility_gate: The five previously available Base-demand cells are not mixed into the surface. They are used only to verify that the new self-contained experiment reproduces the prior batch under the same configuration and seed tuples.

queueing_theory_diagnostics.restriction: Do not hard-code the square-root staffing approximation into the DES and do not present beta as a calibrated service-level target.

ideal_case_comparator.name: DETERMINISTIC_IDEAL_CONTROL_V1
ideal_case_comparator.arrival_process: Perfectly regular arrivals spaced at 1 / arrival_rate_per_second
ideal_case_comparator.service_process: Fixed Security and Immigration service times with pooled FCFS parallel servers
ideal_case_comparator.comparison: Report the stochastic HPP AnyLogic estimate beside the deterministic ideal control and describe their difference as a variability/congestion penalty.
ideal_case_comparator.restriction: Only throughput capacity c / mean_service_seconds is a straight line in c. Do not force the delay response to be linear; the ideal queue may be flat below saturation and increase after the threshold.

analysis.uncertainty: Report replication-level means with 95% intervals and paired differences where CRN alignment passes.
analysis.plot_policy: Simulation estimates at integer capacities are the evidence. A shape-preserving curve may be shown only as a labelled visual guide; it must not imply that fractional service positions were simulated.
analysis.multiplicity_rule: No confirmatory p-value or decision claim. Treat all rankings, thresholds, curvature measures, and interactions as descriptive exploratory findings.
